decisions.briefing: Markets fell today, with tech stocks hit hardest (NASDAQ -1.5%) and the S&P 500 down 0.5%. No stocks passed the screen and conditions are risk-off, so I'm making no new buys and keeping $645.88 in cash. All 7 positions stay open, and the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules will still sell them if they hit -7% or +12%.

market_education.summary_en: The NASDAQ fell 1.5% and the S&P 500 fell 0.5%, so tech and growth stocks dropped much more than the broader market. When the tech-heavy index falls about three times as much as the S&P 500, investors are usually taking profits or moving money out of high-valuation stocks and into safer ones. No news headlines came with today's data, so I can't point to one specific cause, but the pattern fits a risk-off rotation away from momentum stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克指數今日下跌1.5%，標普500指數則回落0.5%，科技及增長股的跌幅明顯大於大市。當以科技股為主的納指跌幅約為標普的三倍時，通常反映投資者正在獲利回吐，或將資金從高估值板塊轉向防守性資產。由於今日未有相關新聞標題，未能確定單一觸發因素，但走勢符合資金撤離動能股的避險輪動格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is when investors get cautious and sell riskier assets like fast-growing tech stocks, moving money into safer places. Tech stocks often fall more than the overall market on these days, which is what happened today. A disciplined investor usually holds off on new purchases until things calm down, instead of buying into a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險情緒」（Risk-Off）是指投資者轉趨審慎，沽售高增長科技股等較高風險的資產，並將資金轉往較安全的投資。在這類交易日，科技股的跌幅往往大於整體大市，正如今日的走勢。紀律嚴謹的投資者通常會暫停建立新倉，待市況回穩後再部署，而非在跌市中逆勢入貨。
